# CAF Guide: code map

**What it is:** An unofficial study app for the Canadian Armed Forces: active-recall flashcards on ranks, structure, training, history and acronyms, with a daily review.
**Live:** https://caf-guide.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/Guild · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** branch-first
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/caf-guide/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms. No "Contact developer" or "Parent company" links (the user's request, 2026-11-09).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py guild` refreshes this map.

## Data tables (`anvil.yaml` db_schema)

- **card_state**: user→users, question→questions, quiz→quizzes, box:num, due:date, reviews:num, lapses:num, last_reviewed:dt · used in QuizService
- **collections**: title:str, description:str, kind:str, color:str, position:num, published:bool, created:dt · used in QuizService
- **questions**: quiz→quizzes, position:num, text:str, answer:str, explanation:str, concept:str · used in QuizService
- **quizzes**: collection→collections, title:str, description:str, difficulty:str, position:num, card_count:num, published:bool, source:str, created:dt · used in QuizService
- **sessions**: user→users, quiz→quizzes, finished:dt, reviewed:num, got:num, again:num, xp:num, ratings:obj · used in QuizService
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, signed_up:dt, display_name:str, bio:str, avatar_color:str, is_admin:bool, xp:num, streak:num, last_active:date, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str · used in QuizService

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
